memory_records.text: Windows install should not require WSL runtime. Ship a Docker image and PowerShell installer for Rust TemporalStore, Codex hook setup, and local ports.
Windows deployment policy: use Docker Desktop with a prepared TemporalStore image; document hook scripts and dependencies; avoid asking users to build inside WSL.
Linux builds should be recommended on Ubuntu 22.04 and Ubuntu 26.04. Add scripts for Linux and macOS deploy, following the OpenViking-style OSS model setup.
OSS model setup uses tools/install_context_oss_models.sh for Ollama, Qwen, vLLM when available, Transformers, sentence-transformers, and local embedding fallback.
First open-source TemporalStore surface should keep Context, Feature, FeatureAggregate, and Control State capabilities only; remove audit, replay, debug-only models, and broad Redis APIs.
Control State stores fast-changing serving signals: counters, caps, quotas, pacing, eligibility, suppression, and risk-control state.

FeatureAggregate lives inside Feature. Feature stores time-keyed observations; FeatureAggregate computes serving-time aggregates over those observations, with immature high-cardinality sketches gated.
Codex hooks must fire from real UserPromptSubmit events across all old and new conversations. Do not use watcher/log fallback as the serving source.
Hook invariant: global hook registration should ingest real user prompts to both Rust and C++ TemporalStore, preserving session/thread identity and enabling query by all sessions.
For C++ vs Rust performance claims, do not use retired matrixark_record_log bridge artifacts. Use direct SDK or mature proxy paths and require selected refs to be non-empty before latency claims.

queries.question: How should Windows users install TemporalStore without WSL?
queries.no_context_answer: I would answer from general project conventions, but I do not have the historical decision context.
queries.with_context_answer: Windows should use Docker Desktop with a prepared TemporalStore image instead of requiring a WSL build/runtime. The install flow should include the PowerShell installer plus Codex hook setup details. Codex prompt capture should use global UserPromptSubmit hook registration for old and new conversations. The hook should write to both Rust and C++ TemporalStore while preserving session/thread identity. Local OSS model setup should use tools/install_context_oss_models.sh. The model path should cover Ollama/Qwen/vLLM when available, Transformers or sentence-transformers, and embedding fallback.
